title: Vox Language & Syntax Audit (2026-08-08)
summary: Empirical audit of the Vox grammar, 743-file corpus, and description-surface drift; evidence base for the core-syntax convergence spec.
notes: Clear audit document with empirical findings (§1-5). Documents discrepancies between grammar SSOT and implementations (formatters, parsers, descriptions). Companion spec exists separately. Shows detailed methodology and corrections from adversarial review. Produces context and evidence, not binding decisions.
